rotor_blade_count.quote: The rotor consisted of 21 blades and had a tip diameter of 17.36 inches, an inlet hub-tip radius ratio of 0.525, an outlet hub-tip ratio of 0.60, and an axial depth of about 3.0 inches.

tip_diameter.quote: had a tip diameter of 17.36 inches

rotor_hub_tip_ratio.quote: an inlet hub-tip radius ratio of 0.525, an outlet hub-tip ratio of 0.60

rotor_axial_depth.quote: an axial depth of about 3.0 inches

rotor_chord_solidity_design.quote: Rotor chord length was 3.25 inches at the tip and 3.0 inches at the hub to give solidities of 1.25 and 2.05, respectively.

stator_blade_count_chord_solidity.quote: Stator chord lengths were 3.2 inches at the tip and 2.65 inches at the hub, giving solidities of 1.05 and 1.42, respectively, for 18 blades.

stator_hub_radius_design.quote: Stator hub radius was constant at 5.2 inches.

edge_radii_design.quote: Blade leading- and trailing-edge radii were about 0.015 to 0.020 inch at all sections for both rotor and stator.

design_tip_speed.quote: Design corrected tip speed of 1000 feet per second was sufficient to produce moderate transonic relative inlet Mach numbers up to about 1.13 without inlet guide vanes at an average inlet axial Mach number of 0.60.

design_weight_flow.unit: lb/sec (29.6 lb/sec per sq ft frontal area)
design_weight_flow.quote: Design corrected weight flow (with inlet wall boundary-layer allowance of 2 percent) was 48.6 pounds per second, or 29.6 pounds per second per square foot of frontal area.

design_pressure_ratio_efficiency.quote: The over-all stage velocity diagram was determined to produce an average pressure ratio of 1.35, an adiabatic efficiency of 0.85, and stator inlet Mach numbers consistent with current practice (approximately 0.75). ... it was necessary to design for a radially increasing total-pressure variation (1.41 at the tip and 1.29 at the hub).

rotor_blockage_assumed.quote: A combined wake and wall boundary-layer area reduction of 8 percent was assumed across the rotor.

no_igv.quote: up to about 1.13 without inlet guide vanes

rotor_design_method.value: moment-of-momentum method with elliptical chordwise pressure loading; sections designed along conical surfaces with linear stream-tube height variation; outlet deviation about 4 deg; average incidence about 3 deg (to mean line at LE)
rotor_design_method.quote: Considerations of assumed blade boundary-layer growth (about 0.08 in. at trailing edge) and outlet air deviation angle (about 4 deg) were then used to establish the blade mean camber line and the exact blade thickness variation. The rotor blades were set for average angle of incidence of about 3 deg.

rotor_thickness_ratio_design.quote: Maximum ratio of blade thickness to blade chord was about 0.06 at the tip and 0.085 at the hub. The blade shape at the tip was very similar to a symmetrical circular-arc profile.

stator_profile.value: symmetrical circular-arc camber line profiles at all radii; t/c 0.06 hub, 0.08 tip (design); setting angles from initial rotor-alone runs
stator_profile.quote: symmetrical circular-arc camber line profiles were used at all radii for the stator. ... Maximum stator thickness ratio was 0.06 at the hub and 0.08 at the tip. ... Blade setting angles were determined from initial runs of the rotor alone.

rotor_measured_thickness_ratio.quote: Measured ratios of maximum blade thickness to chord length were 0.048 at the tip and 0.075 at the hub.

rotor_edge_radii_coordinates.quote: Rotor-blade design coordinates at four reference locations are given in figure 2. Leading- and trailing-edge radii varied from 0.015 to 0.020 inch.

rotor_tip_clearance.quote: Radial clearance between the rotor-blade tip and the outer casing varied from 0.023 to 0.026 inch and the axial clearance between the rotor and the stator at the hub was 1.75 inches.

rotor_stator_axial_clearance_hub.quote: the axial clearance between the rotor and the stator at the hub was 1.75 inches.

stator_construction.value: linear fairing between two circular-arc sections at hub and tip
stator_construction.quote: The stator blades were constructed by linear fairing between two circular-arc sections at the hub and the tip.

stator_inner_casing_radius.quote: The inner casing had a constant radius across the stator (5.186 in.) and a radial clearance of approximately 0.020 inch.

stator_hub_clearance.quote: a radial clearance of approximately 0.020 inch.

stator_measured_thickness_ratio.quote: Measured stator maximum thickness ratios were 0.065 at the hub and 0.084 at the tip. Leading- and trailing-edge radii varied from 0.015 to 0.020 inch.

rotor_coordinates_transformation.value: designed on conical surfaces; fabrication coordinates in planes perpendicular to the stacking radius obtained by graphical fairing; measured rotor inlet mean-line angles about 2 deg higher than the design values of RM E52A24 fig. 8(b)
rotor_coordinates_transformation.quote: The measured rotor-blade-inlet angles of figure 3 are approximately 2 deg higher than the values given in figure 8(b) of reference 1, which were desired design values. The small discrepancy is attributed to the inaccuracies of the transformation process from conical to rectangular coordinates.

rotor_bulb_radius.quote: Radius at bulb CL and radial stacking line, 3.992 inches.

rotor_fig1_dimension_labels.quote: Figure 1 labels: 4.688, 2.598, 1.138 (section heights above bulb CL), 0.502, 8.657 R, 1.542, 3.060, 18°27', Section F-F 0.413, 0.143, 0.340 R

hub_radii_stations.quote: Hub radii at stations 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 are, respectively, 4.312, 4.411, 5.186, 5.186, and 5.186 inches.

value.2: static rake 2.1 in. upstream of the rotor

station_definitions.quote: 3 rotor inlet; 4 rotor outlet (or stator inlet); 5 stator outlet; 6 compressor outlet (discharge measuring station)

rotor_inlet_wall_taps.quote: Because of the projected taper of the rotor blade, the outer-wall taps were 0.70 inch upstream of the rotor leading edge; whereas the inner-wall taps were 0.40 inch upstream of the rotor leading edge.

blade_angle_definition.value: γ° = direction of tangent to blade mean camber line at leading or trailing edge; β, β' measured from axis of rotation; i = angle between inlet relative velocity and tangent to mean line at LE
blade_angle_definition.quote: γ° blade angle, direction of tangent to blade mean camber line at leading or trailing edge, deg
